description: Extracts robust per-epoch EEG features (multiband FFT powers, spectral ratios, amplitude/difference statistics, autocorrelation and Hjorth-style measures), adds unsupervised per-night robust normalization, acausal rolling context, and fixed clock-time features. It fits a class-balanced Extra Trees/Histogram Gradient Boosting ensemble. Leave-one-night-out training predictions select the ensemble mixture, modest class-probability corrections, and transition-smoothing strength using fixed-class macro-F1. Final sequence decoding uses train-label transition associations, never crosses night boundaries, and ignores -1 labels during fitting and transition estimation.
